description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the Pickup class for the OpenCart admin shipping extension. It manages the backend logic for the pickup shipping method, including rendering configuration pages and saving settings.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: Represents the admin controller for managing the Pickup shipping extension in OpenCart. Extends the base Controller class to handle page rendering and settings saving.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, loads existing configuration and related models, and renders the pickup extension configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX request to save the pickup shipping settings, checking permissions and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
